description: Creates a contact, or updates the one that already exists for that phone number or BSUID (the business-scoped user id Meta sends; a contact may have one and no phone). On a contact that exists only the fields you send change, and nothing is removed: tags are added to its tags, attributes are merged into its attributes, changing the name needs an owner or admin, and profile_name is only filled when WhatsApp has not given one; a field sent as null is left as it is. Writes only to Cosend: it sends nothing and the contact is not notified. Who can be messaged stays the same: a send needs no opt-in, only an opt-out stops one, and opt-outs are recorded on their own ledger.

attributes.description: Free-form values. PATCH replaces them whole; a POST for a contact that already exists writes the keys sent over its values and removes none. A key registered in /v1/contact-fields must hold a value of its type (text: a string; number: a number; date: YYYY-MM-DD; boolean: true or false; choice: one of its choices) or null; after a PATCH that sets attributes, or a POST that writes them to a contact that already exists, every required field must have a value. A key that is not registered is kept as it comes.

tags.description: A new contact gets these tags. A contact that already exists gets them added to its own, and keeps every tag it has.

name: upsert_contact
title: Create or update a contact
